children: South Korea's Financial Services Commission has published rules for onchain issuance and circulation of stocks, bonds and funds beginning February 2027. The Korea Securities Depository, the country's central securities depository, is part of the supporting blockchain infrastructure and is building connectivity on Avalanche.

KSD's infrastructure work gives Avalanche an institutional route into South Korea's securities market, described in the event assessment as exceeding $5 trillion. The connection is through securities issuance and circulation infrastructure rather than a standalone crypto product. The market figure indicates the scale of the opportunity, not the value already tokenized or committed to Avalanche.
BREAKING: 🇰🇷 South Korea unveils rules to bring its $5T+ stock market onchain, with Avalanche infrastructure
The Financial Services Commission just published new rules allowing stocks, bonds and funds to be issued and circulated onchain beginning February 2027.

title: Avalanche: KSD builds connectivity for South Korea's onchain securities framework - Feb 2027
